build_scaled_profile_icrh_config: build a scaled-profile ICRH source config with prescribed ion and electron heating profiles and a reference magnetic field
compute_icrh_heating_profiles: compute ion and electron ICRH heating profiles with magnetic-field-dependent resonance shift and power normalisation
build_runtime_params_from_config: build runtime parameters from a scaled-profile ICRH config at a given time step
create_runtime_params_dataclass: create a frozen dataclass holding total power, absorption fraction, heat profiles, and reference B0 for the scaled-profile ICRH model
test_scaled_profile_model_func: test the scaled-profile ICRH model function with runtime params, geometry, and source name to verify shifted and normalised heating profiles
